_comment: 🧩️ The UI module's contribution to the repository test platform. `clsx` and `class-variance-authority` are the published contracts this module's own cn() and styleVariants() re-implement, so they belong to this owner rather than to the test framework.

oracles.rationale: The de-facto specification of recursive class-name flattening: nested arrays, truthy object keys, falsey suppression and numeric coercion. Deterministic, dependency-free, no network, no system dependencies, runs on every platform. Deliberately scoped to the FLATTENING half of the repository's cn() — clsx knows nothing about conflicting utility families, so it is not, and must not be used as, an oracle for conflict resolution.

The published contract that this repository's styleVariants() re-implements: base class, finite variant schema, defaultVariants, boolean choices, compoundVariants with array conditions, and caller class/className overrides. Deterministic, dependency-light, no network. Valid only over UNCLASSIFIED class tokens: styleVariants() finishes through cn(), which additionally resolves repository-owned utility conflicts that cva knows nothing about — the vectors are scoped accordingly.

Judges `presencePaint` of 👥️presence-presentation in `🧪️tests/🔬️unit`: the generated `--presence-N` palette variables (light and dark) and the inline literals past the first cycle must convert to the same sRGB hex as `presenceColor`'s HSL, both converted by d3-color — so every palette slot paints one colour whichever path renders it.

Judges the glass of 🥞️layered-overview-geometry in `🧪️tests/🔬️unit`: for every veil vector of `🧫️fixtures/🥞️layered-overview`, the boolean difference view − hole computed by polygon-clipping must have the area the fixture declares, and so must our single `clip-path: polygon(evenodd, …)` vertex list under the evenodd rule — so one clipped glass layer covers exactly what the landings' four rectangles covered.

Judges `easeInOutCubic` of 🥞️layered-overview-geometry in `🧪️tests/🔬️unit`: the 500 ms reveal/open glide must ease exactly like d3-ease's `easeCubicInOut` at 257 samples of [0, 1], next to the fixture's exact samples.

noOracleDecisions.rationale: cn() resolves conflicts over a finite table of REPOSITORY-OWNED utility families (ui-surface/ui-glass/ui-veil fills, px-single/px-tiny spacing, text-element sizing, border-accent colours). tailwind-merge and every other third-party merger resolve against Tailwind's default scale and know none of these families, so agreeing with one would prove nothing and disagreeing with it would prove nothing either. Choosing such a library purely to satisfy the workflow would be selecting a weak oracle mechanically. The group table in 🟦️.ts is the specification, and the vectors in the feature carry it.
